query.text: 学习助手，请帮我留意孩子的学习状态和坐姿，有不规范的地方提醒他纠正。
query.text_en: Learning Assistant, please help me monitor the child's learning state and sitting posture, and remind him to correct any improper ones.

annotation.text_zh: 请端正坐姿，不要趴在桌上睡觉。
annotation.text_en: Sit up straight and don't sleep on the desk.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
